query: I have an idea for a tool that uses AI to save companies time. Build the Lean Canvas and interview plan.
expected_behavior: Stops because the customer segment and specific job are too vague to form a useful canvas or test
Asks one focused question about who loses time or money and what they do today
Does not fill the nine canvas boxes with invented customer, problem, or channel assumptions
Does not generate a generic interview script until the target segment is identified
Preserves the option to continue the canvas and risk-ranked test after the missing answer is supplied
